name: dmidiplayer

description:
Multiplatform MIDI File Player for Linux, Windows and macOS with advanced features:

• MIDI Output to hardware MIDI ports, or any other Drumstick backend like soft-synths

• Transpose song tonality between -12 and +12 semitones

• Change MIDI volume level (using MIDI CC7)

• Scale song speed between half and double tempo

• Piano Players, MIDI Channels, Rhythm, and Lyrics (Karaoke) views

• Supports .MID (Standard MIDI files), .RMI (RIFF RMID), .KAR (MIDI Karaoke), and .WRK (Cakewalk) file formats

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
